description: This file 'Portability.cpp' provides platform-specific implementations and compatibility functions for different operating systems (Linux, Windows, macOS). It includes functions for sleep, call stack dumping, byte order conversions, and platform-specific system calls, as well as external dependencies and conditional compilation directives.

methods.name: inet_aton
methods.description: Converts IPv4 address from string to network address structure, with platform-specific implementation for Windows.

methods.name: usleep
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of microseconds on Windows.

methods.name: mremap
methods.description: Stub function for memory remapping on macOS.

methods.name: clock_gettime
methods.description: Stub function for clock retrieval on macOS.

methods.name: SleepMs
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of milliseconds on Linux.

methods.name: SleepUs
methods.description: Sleeps for a specified number of microseconds on Linux.

methods.name: htonll
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer from host to network byte order, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: ntohll
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer from network to host byte order, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments into a WPEFramework::Core::string.
